newsitem.title: UK: Commonwealth chief congratulates U.N.'s Annan.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth chief congratulates U.N.'s Annan.

text.p: Commonwealth Secretary-General Chief Emeka Anyaoku on Wednesday congratulated Kofi Annan on his appointment as secretary-general of the United Nations, saying he brought a "wealth of experience and knowledge" to the post.
Annan's appointment was particularly welcome "at this vital time for the world body and for multilateral diplomacy and cooperation in general", Anyaoku said in a statement issued in London.
"You may be assured that the Commonwealth will want to continue to work closely with the United Nations in facing the challenges ahead," he said.
Annan, a 58-year-old U.N. career official from Ghana, was sworn in on Tuesday as the organisation's secretary-general until the year 2001.
The Commonwealth, which groups Britain and many former colonies, has observer status at the United Nations.
